reference_usage: Inspected for art direction; original flat material prompts, no reference pixels copied.

prompts.name: brick_wall
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square flat texture for a low resolution 3D brick railway tunnel above lava. Orthographic material scan, fills entire square, no perspective, no border, no text, no objects, no cast lighting gradients. Coarse crisp pixel art designed to reduce to 128x128 nearest. Limited dark umber, charcoal, rusty brown, muted stone palette. Granular square-pixel surface, stepped shading, no blur, no bloom. A seamless X and Y staggered running-bond wall of dark aged brown bricks with black recessed mortar. About 4 bricks across and 8 rows, irregular stone chips and rusty specks, low contrast neutral lighting. Straight horizontal courses, edges must tile.
